details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_orchestrate_integration_ahead_by_gate.py:entire file (lines 1-603) | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The new integration-ahead-by gate tests are not wired into CI, so the helper logic they exercise is not actually covered.
  WHY: The reviewer says the file is not listed in any workflow and has no entry point, so regressions in the gate helpers would escape CI.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:lines ~478-507 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: Rendering empty JSON arrays as `[]` still consumes prompt budget in `_embed_input_file`.
  WHY: A 2-byte `[]` file is treated as non-empty, so the budget accounting is imprecise even though the practical impact is small.
- scripts/generate_symbol_diff_summary.py:classify_hunk function
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: `classify_hunk` returns `"type": "MODIFIED"` in three places where the intended value is `"UNKNOWN"`.
  WHY: The reviewer identified this as the minimal typo fix and said it only affects the type marker.
- scripts/validate_editor_audit.sh:lines 98-135 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: Unquoted arithmetic inputs from parsed counts can trigger integer-expression errors or mis-evaluation.
  WHY: The reviewer says the arithmetic sum uses external values that may be malformed if jq parsing yields non-digits.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:lines 12809-12810 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The STANDALONE_PRS loop can process an empty or malformed PR number because jq output is not validated before use.
  WHY: `N_PR` is derived from separate jq calls on the same JSON, so malformed or empty JSON can yield an empty string and an invalid PR number.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:lines 12608-12650 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: `_ACTIONS_RUNS_BLOB_CACHE` may be empty when the diagnostic block reads it from the subshell.
  WHY: The reviewer says the cache is populated conditionally, so the diagnostic output can be unreliable when active-workflow detection returns empty.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:lines 5826-5940 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The in-flight review guard can race with cache freshness and the PR head-sha check, letting repeated empty-commit recoveries occur.
  WHY: The reviewer says stale `_ACTIONS_RUNS_BLOB_CACHE` plus head-SHA advancement can let the same recovery action fire repeatedly.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:lines 1357-1377 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: Generating the per-attempt nonce with `/dev/urandom` can fail in restricted environments.
  WHY: The reviewer noted the nonce command has no fallback, so editor attempts can fail before invocation if `/dev/urandom` is unavailable.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:lines 693-703 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The prompt-size check only warns and does not stop codex from running on an over-budget prompt.
  WHY: If the prompt exceeds the safe limit, retries still invoke codex and fail repeatedly, wasting calls.
- scripts/validate_editor_audit.sh:lines 83-94 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The AWK termination pattern can stop at an accidental literal `PR comment audit:` inside user content.
  WHY: That literal matches the exit regex and can truncate the extracted audit section.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:lines 5833-5845 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The in-flight review guard can misclassify the orchestrator's own poll workflow run as an active review run.
  WHY: The reviewer says the poll job appears in the run cache and can make retrigger_review skip a needed empty commit.
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:_parse_iso8601_to_epoch() | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The ISO-8601 parser can raise on GitHub timestamps with microseconds plus trailing `Z` on Python < 3.11.
  WHY: The reviewer says those timestamps can hit `fromisoformat()` without normalization, leaving `head_pushed_at_epoch` unset.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:lines ~6775-6990 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Parse errors or missing cache entries can cause the fresh-push guard to fall through and repeatedly push empty commits.
  WHY: The reviewer says any parse/miss/clock-skew path returns "not fresh", so the same recovery can fire on every poll tick.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:lines ~1248-1743 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Temporary `.attempt_N` prompt files are not cleaned up on refusal/interrupt paths.
  WHY: One reviewer says the EXIT trap misses cleanup if the script is killed mid-attempt, and the other says the refusal fast-path breaks out before removing the attempt file.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:lines ~4001-4048 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The refusal sentinel sets `EDITOR_NOOP_REFUSAL` but the later guard prevents `EDITOR_NOOP_SUSPICIOUS` from being set for refusal runs.
  WHY: The reviewer says downstream steps that key only on `EDITOR_NOOP_SUSPICIOUS` will treat a refusal as a clean noop and may allow unsafe merge behavior.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh + review_autofix.yml + test-and-mark-stable.yml:EDITOR_NOOP_REFUSAL usages | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The new refusal marker is not consumed by the downstream noop-suspicious recovery path.
  WHY: The reviewer says the env var is additive but the poller still only checks the old marker before force-merging, so refusal signals can go unused.
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:lines ~1609-? | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The push re-anchor phase list hard-codes only `ai:done`, creating inconsistent stall behavior between managed and standalone flows.
  WHY: The reviewer says the constant causes detect_stalls to behave differently for the same PR depending on flow.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:_integration_branch_ahead_of_default() (line 2189+) | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The helper assumes raw branch names; passing an already URL-encoded branch name will double-encode it and can 404 the compare API.
  WHY: The reviewer says current callers pass raw names, but the helper contract needs to state that encoded inputs are invalid.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:Prompt budget management (`_embed_input_file`, RB_JUDGE_CONTEXT_BUDGET_BYTES=300000) | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The 300KB budget is smaller than the combined embedded sections, so later general comments can be truncated.
  WHY: The reviewer says the planned sections can total about 350KB, meaning some truncation is guaranteed and important context may be lost.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:line ~697+ `RB_JUDGE_PROMPT_BYTES` check | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: Only the first attempt logs the prompt size, so later retries can show stale diagnostics.
  WHY: The reviewer says `RB_JUDGE_PROMPT_SIZE_LOGGED=false` suppresses updated size logging even if sanitization changes the prompt.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:hard guard warning text change | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The override warning string changed, breaking grep-based downstream tooling that looked for the old text.
  WHY: The reviewer says the new message is intentional but exact-string consumers will no longer match.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
